name: How long does a typical kitchen clearance improvement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen clearance improvement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for kitchen clearance improvements depends on the complexity and extent of the modifications. Simple adjustments, such as repositioning a range hood or trimming a countertop, might take a day or two. Projects involving cabinet relocation, plumbing, or electrical work, or minor demolition, can extend to several days or even a couple of weeks. We provide a detailed project schedule after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies. Simple adjustments take days, while complex changes involving utility work can take weeks.
